# Rapydo

> > Rapydo is a database operations platform providing monitoring, automation, and optimization tools for AWS RDS, Aurora, MySQL, and PostgreSQL databases.

The platform offers two main products: Rapydo Scout for query monitoring and Rapydo Cortex for automated database optimization. Founded by Phillip Hamilton and Tal Tamir, Rapydo focuses on DBA automation, query performance tuning, and real-time database observability for cloud-native teams.

## Key Topics

- Rapydo Scout
- Rapydo Cortex
- MySQL
- PostgreSQL
- AWS RDS
- Database optimization
- Query optimization
- Database monitoring
- Cloud database
- SQL performance tuning
- Real-time monitoring
- DevOps tools
- Database administration
- HTAP (Hybrid Transactional/Analytical Processing)
- Index optimization

## Database Optimization Guides

- [Slow Queries: How to Detect and Optimize in MySQL and PostgreSQL](https://rapydo.io/blog/slow-queries-how-to-detect-and-optimize-in-mysql-and-postgresql): Guide to detecting & optimizing slow queries in MySQL and PostgreSQL
- [Optimizing SQL Indexes in PostgreSQL and MySQL](https://rapydo.io/blog/optimizing-sql-indexes-in-postgresql-and-mysql): Index optimization guide for PostgreSQL & MySQL with B-tree, GIN, GiST examples
- [Fixing High CPU & Memory Usage in AWS RDS](https://rapydo.io/blog/fixing-high-cpu-memory-usage-in-aws-rds-joxbt): Troubleshooting AWS RDS high CPU/memory with CloudWatch & query optimization
- [Deep Dive into MySQL Internals: A Comprehensive Guide for DBAs - Part I](https://rapydo.io/blog/deep-dive-into-mysql-internals-a-comprehensive-guide-for-dbas---part-i): MySQL internals guide covering InnoDB, query execution & performance tuning
- [Optimizing Multi-Database Operations with Execute Query](https://rapydo.io/blog/execute-query): Multi-database MySQL operations using Execute Query for cross-DB analytics
